programme.desc: Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

programme.title: The Catholic Guy
programme.desc: Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh.

programme.title: Mums at the Table
programme.desc: At The Table is where we share, laugh and dream. Real women, real conversations, real issues. It's where you'll find information on family, health and spirituality, but most of all, a community doing motherhood together.

programme.title: Faith Runs Deep
programme.desc: Faith Runs Deep is the new series from the producers of the award-winning program, Jesus the Game Changer. Host Karl Faase travels around Australia, discovering the rich and inspiring history of faith Down Under.

programme.title: Letters from Mother Teresa
programme.desc: A drama that explores the life of Mother Teresa (Juliet Stevenson) through letters she wrote to her longtime friend and spiritual advisor, Father Celeste van Exem (Max von Sydow) over a nearly fifty-year period.

programme.title: Hour of Power
programme.desc: Exciting interviews, inspiring music, and encouraging messages filled with spiritual principles and practices to help people live lives of meaning.

programme.title: LIFETV with Paul de Jong
programme.desc: Presented by Paul de Jong - Senior Pastor of LIFE, LIFETV broadcasts around the world including New Zealand, Australia, Indonesia, England, Canada and the USA.

programme.title: Answers with Bayless Conley
programme.desc: Tough times are inevitable in life. So how can you rejoice when circumstances are hard? In Lessons from Philippians: Unspeakable Joy, Pastor Bayless explains that true joy does not depend on whats happening around us, but on the Lord.

programme.title: Enjoying Everyday Life
programme.desc: With her no nonsense preaching Joyce Meyer shares practical teaching about living life as a Christian. In an encouraging and supportive way, hear real stories that will challenge you to be the best that you can be.

programme.title: Katherine Ruonala
programme.desc: Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls.

programme.title: Letters from Mother Teresa
programme.desc: A drama that explores the life of Mother Teresa (Juliet Stevenson) through letters she wrote to her longtime friend and spiritual advisor, Father Celeste van Exem (Max von Sydow) over a nearly fifty-year period.

programme.title: Compassion Stories
programme.desc: Compassion stories from child sponsorship highlight how sponsorship provides education, healthcare, and mentorship, changing children's lives from poverty to hope.

programme.title: David Jeremiah
programme.desc: Join us for the weekly church service conducted by David Jeremiah from San Diego, California, USA. Dedicated to providing sound, in-depth teaching of the Word of God verse by verse. Through his personable and expository teaching.

programme.title: My 7 Grandmas
programme.desc: 17-year-old Gigi (Kate Larson) moves with her mom (Candace Kirkpatrick) from California to small-town Minnesota, where she cleverly plots to help her Grandpa (comedian Jeff Allen) get his life back on track after the loss of his wife.
